author: motion_reconstruction
scope: Read-only geometry diagnosis of the 31,576-triangle front fascia shown in glass-v3.png. No quality score requested or assigned.
observation: The broad front white corners have warped dents and protruding peaks; the lower black opening is partly filled by a forward cap, yielding stacked horizontal slabs. D02 and approved front-v2 show coherent white corner planes around one deep dark opening.

findings.cause: The added FrontFenderTerminal solids use strongly nonplanar broad quads, then boolean-union them into BodyShell.
findings.method: For each authored four-vertex face, normalize cross(v1-v0,v2-v0); report dot(v3-v0,normal). Mirrored side has equal magnitude.
findings.implication: A 54 mm warp across an intended broad corner panel must triangulate into separate planes. Recalculating unit normals cannot flatten it. Boolean intersection fragments and mixed smoothness reveal these diagonal dents.
findings.repair: Replace the overlapping warped hexahedron/union with explicit front cheek surface patches sharing the body/hood/opening/wheel-arch boundaries. Use one or two coherent designed planes for broad facets; use small quads on a smooth analytic patch where curvature is intended. Reuse boundary vertices instead of crossing two independently authored skins.

findings.cause: Upper cheek controls overshoot the fitted body surface and create actual protruding white horns.
findings.method: Evaluate the same front-region dimension()/deck() interpolation from surface-patches.json at each cheek point XY; compare authored Z.
findings.repair: Derive the terminal upper/back boundary from the same deck/hood crown and fender shoulder controls used by BodyShell. Remove the 16-24 cm discontinuity before normal or material changes. Preserve the strong source front corner silhouette without adding independent raised peaks.

findings.cause: Only BodyShell is cut for the front opening; Undercarriage retains its original front cap in front of the recess.
findings.method: Parse public/models/roadster.glb with the installed GLTFLoader, update matrixWorld, and raycast through the front center. Coordinates are the canonical runtime model axes.
findings.repair: Apply the same opening volume to the belt or omit/trim its front center faces. Retain one designed lower splitter/lip and the jambs. Recess the dark back behind the mouth; do not leave a full-width uncut cap ahead of it. Check the low front and quarter views after rebuilding.

findings.cause: Smoothness is reassigned independently per final triangle by a normal component threshold.
findings.evidence: face.use_smooth = glass or not(abs(face.normal.x)>.85 and z<1.0)
findings.implication: Neighboring fragments of the same intended cheek surface can cross the normal threshold and get different smooth/flat shading. Global triangulation and booleans turn that heuristic into a patchwork. This compounds actual geometry warp; it is not the primary cause of the silhouette defects.
findings.repair: After repairing the surface, assign smooth/flat behavior by coherent semantic surface regions and deliberate sharp edges. Smooth within fender curvature; preserve designed hood/cheek creases. A normal-weighting pass may help planar-panel shading but cannot repair the current warped shape.

negative_findings: FrontRecessBack exported triangle normals point forward (+X canonical), so its back-facing normal is not the mouth defect.
The examined front components export DoubleSide materials, so disappearing single-sided recess faces do not explain the stacked cap.
The validation report has zero degenerate triangles and unit normals. Those checks do not assess broad face planarity, surface overshoot, occluding duplicate volumes or semantic normal continuity.
recommended_order: Remove/trim the surviving lower-mouth belt cap.
Replace warped cheek solids with boundary-consistent front patches, deriving upper boundaries from the body controls.
Cut/place lamp apertures on those final clean planes; use offset/depth from their surface frame.
Assign coherent sharp/smooth regions after final topology.
Inspect front and front-quarter clay plus material renders before adding more cosmetics.
acceptance_checks: Center-mouth front rays through heights .20-.50 m hit the intended recessed interior/jamb, with only the explicit thin lower lip crossing its designed height.
No broad intended planar cheek quad has centimetre-scale planarity error.
Cheek boundary vertices coincide with intended deck/hood/arch boundaries instead of protruding 0.16-.24 m above them.
Front and low front-quarter silhouettes match D02/approved front-v2 without protruding white horns or a forward lower cap.
Normals remain finite/unit and no zero-area triangles are introduced; verify shading continuity visually as an additional check.
coordination: Read-only findings were sent directly to /root/tripo_pipeline and /root. No app/model files, .blend data or public exports were edited. No live browser automation or Blender mutation was used.
